# Verification record 2026-10-10-macos-26-apple-m5-max

**Verification is evidence, not a support guarantee.** This record is the result of one full nightly run of the [compatibility matrix](../cells/COMPATIBILITY.md) at commit `3985b7f4e41fed7439613ac88837c5b3f1c73db3` on macos-26-apple-m5-max, with each render backend checked separately. The machine-readable record is [2026-10-10-macos-26-apple-m5-max.json](2026-10-10-macos-26-apple-m5-max.json); `verifiedRanges` in [seed.json](../seed.json) is derived from the records (`node design/compatibility/verification.mjs ranges`), and `validate.mjs` checks that they agree.

**Rendering: hardware (GPU profile `hardware`).** Real GPU: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5 Max, Unspecified Version); apple / metal-3, isFallbackAdapter false. The render check confirmed no backend ran on a software renderer or a fallback adapter.

Rule: A tuple (React adapter, exact React, Pixi adapter, exact pixi.js) is verified on a render backend when its cell passed on that backend in this record (every command, every conformance scenario and the render check) and every boundary probe and every negative case of this record behaved as expected. A backend run that applied an environment shim (adapterMatrix.environmentShims, a labelled workaround for an upstream pixi.js bug) is judged like any other: a pass verifies the tuple, which carries the shim id, and a failure is a failure. A run a record before 2026-10-11 lists as an expected blank render (the retired expectedBlankRender list) verifies nothing. Each tuple lists every backend it is verified on; backends are never inferred from each other.

## Environment shims and known issues

\* WebGPU on pixi.js <8.10 needs the workaround for [pixijs/pixijs#11389](https://github.com/pixijs/pixijs/issues/11389) (fixed in 8.10.0): without it, WebGPU renders a blank canvas on devices whose WebGL texture-unit count exceeds their WebGPU per-stage limit. Use pixi.js 8.10+ or WebGL. The verification runs apply that workaround as the labelled environment shim `pixi-webgpu-texture-units` (`adapterMatrix.environmentShims`). This record verified 64 WebGPU tuples it covers (pixi.js 8.2.6, 8.3.4, 8.4.1, 8.5.2, 8.6.6, 8.7.3, 8.8.1, 8.9.2), marked in the cells table; they stay verified (owner rulings 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-11).

- No environment shim was applied: this record ran before environment shims existed (2026-10-11).

## Findings

- Added 2026-10-11 (no re-run): this record ran before environment shims existed, so none was applied. The shim pixi-webgpu-texture-units (adapterMatrix.environmentShims) is a no-op on this machine: this record did not measure MAX_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS, but the later full record 2026-10-11-macos-26-apple-m5-max did, measuring 16 (16 → 16 on all 88 shimmed runs), which is at most WebGPU's default maxSampledTexturesPerShaderStage (16). That is why pixi.js 8.2.6 to 8.9.2 rendered on WebGPU here without it (pixijs/pixijs#11389 needs a WebGL texture-unit count above the WebGPU per-stage limit). The record stays valid as recorded.

## Data only, not verified

**Data only, not verified: these results are never verification, never enter verifiedRanges and never change a peer range.**

Data-only probes (issue 17). Each probe installs the packed adapters beside a React or pixi.js the adapter does not declare, ignoring peers, and records what every cell command does. The adapters' environment checks are bypassed in the conformance run only (cell.json dataOnly.bypassEnvironmentCheck), so the suite shows what would happen past them. Results are data, never verification: nothing here enters verifiedRanges or changes a peer range.

### pixi7-earlier-releases

The Pixi 7 adapter on pixi.js releases below its 7.4.2 floor: the highest patch of 7.0 to 7.3, and 7.4.0 (7.4.1 was never published to npm).

- pixi.js 7.4.1: not run, absent from the npm registry's version list and time map: there is nothing to install.

### react18-earlier-minors

The React 18 adapter on React 18.0, 18.1 and 18.2, each with the react-reconciler released with it (npm peers: 0.27.0 react ^18.0.0, 0.28.0 react ^18.1.0, 0.29.0 react ^18.2.0; 0.29.2, which the adapter depends on, declares react ^18.3.1). The reconciler is swapped with an npm override in the cell project only; the shipped adapter is unchanged. @types/react stays at the adapter's audited 18.3 declarations.
